word: We save money to decorate the street for the party.
answer: Ahorramos dinero para decorar la calle para la fiesta.

word: Neighbors rent speakers and colorful lights.
answer: Los vecinos rentan bocinas y luces de colores.

word: Everyone helps set up the tables.
answer: Todos ayudan a acomodar las mesas.

word: Kids dance in the middle of the street.
answer: Los niños bailan en medio de la calle.

word: Parents look for chairs for the grandparents.
answer: Los papás buscan sillas para los abuelos.

word: The music changes from slow to fast.
answer: La música cambia de lenta a rápida.

word: We walk around greeting every family.
They cancel the raffle because the tickets get lost.
answer: Cancelan la rifa porque se pierden los boletos.

word: People cook big pots of food for everyone.
answer: La gente cocina ollas grandes de comida para todos.

word: At the end we buy ice cream from a small cart.
answer: Al final compramos helado de un carrito.
